what_happened: Layout 9, red-white Straw010, GlassCup022 (same layout as success s17). Stage 0 at 190. Straw grasped 305-315, lifted 0.73 m and held vertically (width 0.013); navigation 318-~690. 740-797 the straw hung vertically just right of the cup. It was released at 797 with its centre 5.3 cm from the cup centre, just outside the rim; it never touched the cup (at_target never held) and leaned. At 805 the gripper grasped it again (hold 805-884, lift 0.136 m), lifted it diagonally and released it at 884 over the counter edge; the straw fell onto a stool (end z 0.81, 0.136 m from the cup). After that the arm wandered (closes none).
causal_chain: straw vertical beside the cup 740-797 -> released 5 cm off-centre, outside the rim (797) -> re-grasped (805) and dropped it off the counter edge onto a stool (884) -> unrecoverable
self_recovery: Re-grasped the straw 8 steps after releasing it (805) and lifted it 13.6 cm, but released it again at 884 over the counter edge; the fix made it worse.
official_criterion_notes: Official success = straw touches the cup AND straw centre < 0.5 m horizontally from the cup centre AND gripper far; there is no 'inside' or upright test, so a straw lying across the rim or leaning on the outside of the cup would count once the gripper leaves.

uncertain_about: Why it re-grasped: possibly reacting to the straw tipping against the cup.
